description: 100-query annotated multimodal visual retrieval benchmark spanning speech ASR and on-screen visual OCR text across 10 core video engineering domains.

corpus.text: FFmpeg extracts 16kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV audio tracks for Whisper ASR.
The ffprobe utility probes container duration, resolution, FPS, and codec details.
H.264 video decoding utilizes libx264 software decoding on host CPU cores.
Keyframe thumbnails are generated at 1-second intervals via ffmpeg seek flags.
The imageio-ffmpeg library provides a bundled zero-install fallback binary.
Lossless video trimming copies streams using ffmpeg -c copy without re-encoding.
Probing falls back to parsing ffmpeg stderr when ffprobe is absent.
Synthetic test video clips are synthesized using the lavfi testsrc filter.
The WebM and Matroska container formats support Opus and Vorbis audio codecs.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Slide: Video Media Ingestion Pipeline Architecture Overview.
Faster-Whisper utilizes CTranslate2 for fast quantized offline speech recognition.
CTranslate2 int8 quantization reduces RAM usage while maintaining word accuracy.
Whisper detects spoken languages including English, Hindi, and Hinglish code-switching.
Word-level and segment-level millisecond timestamps are preserved for each spoken sentence.
Speech transcription runs locally on CPU without requiring cloud API connections.
Temperature sampling fallback is used when Whisper ASR encounters low confidence.
VAD voice activity detection filters out silence before passing audio to Whisper.
CTranslate2 executes optimized matrix operations using AVX2 CPU instructions.
Confidence scores between 0.0 and 1.0 are attached to each generated transcript segment.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Terminal: faster-whisper --model base.en --device cpu --compute_type int8
PySceneDetect detects visual scene cuts by analyzing color histogram variations between frames.
The ContentDetector algorithm identifies abrupt camera cuts based on threshold deltas.
Midpoint keyframes are extracted for each detected video scene boundary.
Adaptive detector adjusts thresholds dynamically for gradual fades and dissolves.
Scene records store start_time, end_time, duration, and thumbnail file paths.
Threshold fallback handles synthetic and low-motion presentation videos.
PySceneDetect runs frame downscaling to 160x120 to accelerate cut detection.
Scene boundaries group related visual keyframes into coherent chapter candidates.
Representative frame images are saved as JPEG files under data/thumbnails.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Graph: Delta intensity curves showing scene transition markers.
ChromaDB provides local embedded persistent vector storage under data/vectors.
Sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 outputs 384-dimensional dense semantic vectors.
Cosine similarity computes vector proximity using L2-normalized embedding vectors.
ChromaDB collections index transcript chunk text alongside video ID metadata.
Dense vector retrieval identifies semantically equivalent phrases with different vocabulary.
Overlapping window chunking slices transcripts into 30-second semantic blocks.
Batch embedding generation vectorizes 32 transcript chunks in a single PyTorch forward pass.
HuggingFace sentence-transformers runs offline inference using cached model weights.
Vector IDs map directly to SQLite embedding records for bi-directional lookup.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Diagram: 384-dimensional vector space clustering technical concepts.
SQLite FTS5 virtual tables enable fast BM25 ranked full-text keyword search.
Exact technical acronyms like RRF, MCP, and ASR are retrieved reliably via FTS5.
The porter stemmer normalizes word variations like index, indexing, and indexed.
FTS5 match syntax supports prefix queries using the wildcard asterisk operator.
SQLite FTS5 snippet function returns highlighted search terms with surrounding context.
Relational video metadata in SQLite is linked to FTS5 rowids via foreign key cascades.
BM25 weights term frequency against inverse document frequency across chunks.
SQLite database transactions ensure ACID compliance during batch index insertion.
FTS5 contentless tables optimize disk usage by referencing the primary segment table.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Code: SELECT snippet(transcript_segments_fts, 0, '', '', '...', 10) FROM fts;
Cross-encoder models score query and candidate passages jointly via full cross-attention.
The ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 model provides state-of-the-art re-ranking accuracy.
Two-stage retrieval combines fast bi-encoder candidate retrieval with cross-encoder scoring.
Cross-encoders resolve lexical ambiguities that bi-encoder cosine similarity misses.
Top-20 candidates from stage 1 are passed to stage 2 re-ranking to balance speed and quality.
PyTorch evaluation mode disables dropout for deterministic re-ranking scores.
Softmax normalization converts raw logit scores into bounded probabilities.
Latency profiling measures the millisecond cost of cross-encoder attention layers.
Cross-encoder re-ranking increases NDCG@10 by up to 25% over baseline dense search.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Benchmark: Bi-Encoder Recall vs Cross-Encoder MRR Comparison Chart.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges diverse retrieval rankings using reciprocal position weights.
The constant k parameter in RRF is conventionally set to 60 to soften top-rank bias.
RRF formula calculates score as the sum of 1 divided by k plus rank index for each document.
Hybrid search combines dense vector ranks and lexical BM25 ranks via RRF.
Documents appearing in both semantic and lexical result sets receive highest reciprocal scores.
RRF operates without requiring score calibration or scale normalization across engines.
Weighted RRF allows tuning the relative influence of vector versus keyword retrieval.
Rank fusion prevents catastrophic recall failures when users search rare domain jargon.
Evaluation harnesses compare pure dense, pure lexical, and RRF fused retrieval metrics.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Formula: RRF_score(d) = sum_{m in M} 1 / (60 + r_m(d))
The Model Context Protocol MCP connects AI agents to local video retrieval tools.
FastMCP STDIO transport communicates via JSON-RPC messages over standard input and output.
All logging in MCP servers must be routed to stderr to avoid corrupting JSON-RPC streams.
The list_videos tool returns paged inventories of indexed media with status filters.
The search_video_content tool executes hybrid search returning timestamp intervals.
The find_video_clips tool retrieves candidate video time ranges bounded by duration limits.
The summarize_video tool delivers factual summaries strictly grounded in transcripts.
Claude Desktop connects to Arova via claude_desktop_config.json configuration blocks.
The export_video_clip tool is gated behind explicit developer opt-in for security.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: JSON: mcpServers configuration snippet for Claude and Cursor IDE.
The Hallmark design system eliminates AI slop with tokenized dark technical palettes.
HTML5 video streaming uses HTTP 206 Partial Content Range headers for instant seeking.
The precision video scrubber supports variable playback rates from 0.75x to 2x speed.
Multi-track synchronized timelines display transcripts, visual scenes, and AI chapters together.
Clicking a transcript citation instantly jumps the HTML5 video player to that timestamp.
Dark mode background colors use high contrast token #060911 for developer focus.
CSS overflow-x clip prevents horizontal layout shifts during timeline animations.
The reduced motion media query disables animations for users with vestibular sensitivity.
Instant focus rings with 2px offset provide accessible keyboard navigation.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Interface: 12-column fullscreen video intelligence studio workstation.
Deny-by-default filesystem roots reject path traversal attempts outside allowed directories.
Canonical path resolution prevents directory traversal via dot-dot and symlink escapes.
Source video files are strictly immutable; index deletion never removes source media.
The backend API binds exclusively to loopback 127.0.0.1 by default for local privacy.
Media-derived text is sanitized before prompt assembly to neutralize prompt injections.
Zero remote telemetry and zero silent cloud fallbacks preserve user data confidentiality.
CycloneDX SBOM artifacts inventory all dependencies and licenses for audit compliance.
Non-destructive doctor diagnostics inspect system readiness without mutating local state.
FastMCP agent tools enforce a read-only contract preventing unauthorized file publishing.
[On-Screen Visual Text]: Policy: Strict IP Boundary protecting commercial Creator OS secrets.
